queries.sql: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), ranked AS (SELECT UserID, dom, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY dom) AS rn FROM ud) SELECT s.dom - f.dom AS gap_days, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(f.dom) AS avg_first_day FROM (SELECT UserID, dom FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) AS f JOIN (SELECT UserID, dom FROM ranked WHERE rn = 2) AS s ON s.UserID = f.UserID GROUP BY gap_days ORDER BY gap_days
queries.description: Distribution of days between a user's first and second active day in July.

queries.sql: SELECT UPPER(TRIM(PageCharset)) AS charset_norm, CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY c DESC, UserID LIMIT 1000) AS top_u) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_power_user, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE PageCharset <> '' GROUP BY charset_norm, is_power_user HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY is_power_user DESC, hit_count DESC, charset_norm LIMIT 50
queries.description: Normalized page charsets seen by the 1000 most active users versus everyone else.

queries.sql: WITH user_days AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(dom) AS cohort_day FROM user_days GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.cohort_day, COUNT(DISTINCT f.UserID) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.dom = f.cohort_day + 1 THEN ud.UserID END) AS d1_retained, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.dom = f.cohort_day + 7 THEN ud.UserID END) AS d7_retained FROM firsts f JOIN user_days ud ON ud.UserID = f.UserID WHERE f.cohort_day <= 24 GROUP BY f.cohort_day ORDER BY f.cohort_day
queries.description: Daily acquisition cohorts with day-1 and day-7 retention counts.

queries.sql: SELECT device, OS, u FROM (SELECT device, OS, u, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY u DESC, OS) AS rn FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN IsMobile <> 0 THEN 'mobile' ELSE 'desktop' END AS device, OS, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN IsMobile <> 0 THEN 'mobile' ELSE 'desktop' END, OS) g) r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY device, rn
queries.description: Top three operating systems by distinct users for mobile and for desktop.

queries.sql: SELECT LENGTH(ua) AS version_len, COUNT(*) AS versions FROM (SELECT UserAgentMinor AS ua FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserAgentMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 INTERSECT SELECT UserAgentMinor AS ua FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY UserAgentMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) AS x GROUP BY LENGTH(ua) ORDER BY version_len
queries.description: Finds browser minor versions seen at least 10 times on both mobile and desktop, then counts them by length of the version string.

queries.sql: SELECT d.RegionID, COUNT(*) AS desktop_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT d.UserID) AS desktop_users FROM hits d WHERE d.IsMobile = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits m WHERE m.RegionID = d.RegionID AND m.IsMobile <> 0) GROUP BY d.RegionID ORDER BY desktop_hits DESC, d.RegionID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Largest regions that have desktop traffic but never a single mobile hit.

queries.sql: SELECT d, TraficSourceID, src_hits, CAST(src_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(day_total, 0) AS share FROM (SELECT d, TraficSourceID, src_hits, SUM(src_hits) OVER (PARTITION BY d) AS day_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d ORDER BY src_hits DESC, TraficSourceID) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS d, TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS src_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate), TraficSourceID) AS a) AS b WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY d
queries.description: For each day of July, identifies the dominant traffic source and its share of that day's hits.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS mobile_share FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 AND CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY mobile_share DESC, total_hits DESC, CounterID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Sizable counters whose mobile share is above the global mobile share, most mobile-heavy first.

queries.sql: SELECT step, stage, users FROM (WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS days_active, MAX(IsNotBounce) AS engaged FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT 1 AS step, 'any_visit' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS users FROM u UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS step, 'engaged' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS users FROM u WHERE engaged = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS step, 'engaged_2_days' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS users FROM u WHERE engaged = 1 AND days_active >= 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS step, 'engaged_7_days' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS users FROM u WHERE engaged = 1 AND days_active >= 7) AS f ORDER BY step
queries.description: Retention funnel: all users, engaged users, and engaged users returning on at least 2 and 7 distinct days.

queries.sql: WITH top_pages AS (SELECT URL AS page, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY URL ORDER BY views DESC, page LIMIT 30), outflow AS (SELECT Referer AS page, COUNT(*) AS out_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS out_users FROM hits WHERE Referer IN (SELECT page FROM top_pages) GROUP BY Referer) SELECT t.page, t.views, COALESCE(o.out_hits, 0) AS onward_hits, COALESCE(o.out_users, 0) AS onward_users, CAST(COALESCE(o.out_hits, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t.views, 0) AS onward_ratio FROM top_pages t LEFT JOIN outflow o ON o.page = t.page ORDER BY t.views DESC, t.page
queries.description: For the 30 most viewed pages, how many subsequent hits and users they sent onward as referers.

queries.sql: SELECT m.EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT m.UserID) AS cross_device_users, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits_of_cross_users FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.UserID = m.UserID AND d.EventDate = m.EventDate AND d.IsMobile = 0) GROUP BY m.EventDate ORDER BY m.EventDate
queries.description: Per day, the number of mobile users who also produced desktop hits on the same day.

queries.sql: SELECT NetMajor, NetMinor, CAST(NetMajor AS VARCHAR) || '.' || CAST(NetMinor AS VARCHAR) AS net_version, users, CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(users) OVER (PARTITION BY NetMajor), 0) AS share_in_major FROM (SELECT NetMajor, NetMinor, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE NetMajor > 0 GROUP BY NetMajor, NetMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) AS v ORDER BY NetMajor, NetMinor LIMIT 100
queries.description: .NET framework versions with distinct users and each minor version's share within its major version.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, URLCategoryID, users, rnk FROM (SELECT EventDate, URLCategoryID, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY users DESC, URLCategoryID) AS rnk FROM (SELECT EventDate, URLCategoryID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE URLCategoryID <> 0 GROUP BY EventDate, URLCategoryID) AS d) AS r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY EventDate, rnk
queries.description: For each day of July, the three URL categories reaching the most distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH per_counter AS (SELECT CounterID, AVG(ConnectTiming) AS avg_connect, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_share, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE ConnectTiming > 0 GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500), ranked AS (SELECT CounterID, avg_connect, engaged_share, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_connect, CounterID) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM per_counter) SELECT CASE WHEN rn * 4 <= n THEN 1 WHEN rn * 2 <= n THEN 2 WHEN rn * 4 <= n * 3 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS speed_quartile, COUNT(*) AS counters, MIN(avg_connect) AS min_avg_connect, MAX(avg_connect) AS max_avg_connect, AVG(engaged_share) AS avg_engaged_share FROM ranked GROUP BY speed_quartile ORDER BY speed_quartile
queries.description: Counters split into quartiles by average connect timing, comparing engagement between fast and slow sites.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), monthly AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 1000) SELECT m.CounterID, m.mau, AVG(d.dau) AS avg_dau, CAST(AVG(d.dau) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / m.mau AS stickiness, COUNT(*) AS active_days FROM monthly m JOIN daily d ON d.CounterID = m.CounterID GROUP BY m.CounterID, m.mau ORDER BY stickiness DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Stickiest counters by average daily active users divided by monthly active users, among counters with at least 1000 users.

queries.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits), 0) AS reach_share FROM hits GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day
queries.description: Share of the whole monthly audience that is ever active in each hour of the day.

queries.sql: WITH parent AS (SELECT UserID, WindowName, COUNT(*) AS parent_hits FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, WindowName), child AS (SELECT UserID, OpenerName, COUNT(*) AS child_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT WindowName) AS child_windows FROM hits WHERE OpenerName <> 0 GROUP BY UserID, OpenerName) SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.child_windows, 0) >= 5 THEN 5 ELSE COALESCE(c.child_windows, 0) END AS children_bucket, COUNT(*) AS parent_windows, SUM(p.parent_hits) AS parent_hit_total, SUM(COALESCE(c.child_hits, 0)) AS child_hit_total FROM parent AS p LEFT JOIN child AS c ON p.UserID = c.UserID AND p.WindowName = c.OpenerName GROUP BY children_bucket ORDER BY children_bucket
queries.description: Matches each user's browser windows to the windows they opened (OpenerName equal to WindowName) and groups parent windows by how many child windows they spawned, capped at 5.

queries.sql: SELECT hr, UserAgent, c FROM (SELECT hr, UserAgent, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY c DESC, UserAgent) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, UserAgent, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE IsMobile <> 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime), UserAgent) g) r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY hr, rn
queries.description: For each hour of the day, the two most frequent user agents among mobile hits.

queries.sql: SELECT plugin, version_code, users, hit_count FROM (SELECT 'silverlight1' AS plugin, SilverlightVersion1 AS version_code, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion1 > 0 GROUP BY SilverlightVersion1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 100 UNION ALL SELECT 'silverlight2' AS plugin, SilverlightVersion2 AS version_code, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion2 > 0 GROUP BY SilverlightVersion2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 100 UNION ALL SELECT 'flash_major' AS plugin, FlashMajor AS version_code, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE FlashMajor > 0 GROUP BY FlashMajor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 100) AS p ORDER BY plugin, users DESC, version_code LIMIT 100
queries.description: Plugin version adoption by distinct users across Silverlight major and minor versions and Flash major versions, keeping only versions with at least 100 users.

queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mob, COUNT(*) AS total FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) SELECT cur.dom, cur.mob, prev.mob AS prev_mob, cur.mob - prev.mob AS mob_delta, CAST(cur.mob AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(cur.total, 0) - CAST(prev.mob AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(prev.total, 0) AS share_delta FROM d cur JOIN d prev ON cur.dom = prev.dom + 1 ORDER BY cur.dom
queries.description: Day-over-day change in mobile hits and in mobile share, via a self-join of daily aggregates on consecutive days.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c < 100 THEN 1 WHEN c < 10000 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS size_bucket, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(c) AS hits_total FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE CounterID NOT IN (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile <> 0) GROUP BY CounterID) t GROUP BY CASE WHEN c < 100 THEN 1 WHEN c < 10000 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ORDER BY size_bucket
queries.description: Size distribution of desktop-only counters that never received a mobile hit.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_share FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 AND AVG(IsNotBounce) > (SELECT AVG(IsNotBounce) FROM hits) ORDER BY users DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Largest counters (by users) whose non-bounce rate beats the site-wide average.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, CounterID, mobile_hits, desktop_hits FROM (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, mobile_hits, desktop_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, CounterID) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, CounterID) g) r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: For each day, the counter with the most mobile hits alongside its desktop hits.

queries.sql: WITH ad AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(URL FROM 1 FOR 30) AS url_prefix, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND URL <> '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(URL FROM 1 FOR 30)), org AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(URL FROM 1 FOR 30) AS url_prefix, COUNT(*) AS organic_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID = 0 AND SearchEngineID <> 0 AND URL <> '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(URL FROM 1 FOR 30)) SELECT ad.url_prefix, ad.ad_hits, COALESCE(org.organic_hits, 0) AS organic_hits FROM ad LEFT JOIN org ON ad.url_prefix = org.url_prefix ORDER BY ad.ad_hits DESC, ad.url_prefix LIMIT 25
queries.description: For the 25 most ad-driven landing-page prefixes (first 30 characters of the URL), compares paid hits with organic search hits on the same prefix.

queries.sql: SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(CASE WHEN active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS return_rate, AVG(active_days) AS avg_active_days FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS first_day, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) AS u GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day
queries.description: Builds daily acquisition cohorts from each user's first active day in July and reports cohort size, the number and rate of returning users, and average active days.

queries.sql: SELECT IsMobile, COUNT(*) AS retained_users FROM (SELECT UserID, IsMobile FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID, IsMobile INTERSECT SELECT UserID, IsMobile FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31' GROUP BY UserID, IsMobile) AS r GROUP BY IsMobile ORDER BY IsMobile
queries.description: Number of users seen on the same device type (mobile or desktop) in both the first and the last week of July.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS search_hits FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID), a AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN a.ad_hits >= 10 THEN 3 WHEN a.ad_hits >= 3 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS ad_exposure_level, COUNT(*) AS user_cnt, SUM(s.search_hits) AS search_hit_total, AVG(s.search_hits) AS avg_search_hits FROM s INNER JOIN a ON s.UserID = a.UserID GROUP BY ad_exposure_level ORDER BY ad_exposure_level
queries.description: Among users who both searched and saw ad traffic, groups them by ad exposure level and measures their search activity.

queries.sql: SELECT TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS user_cnt, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_hits FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND EventDate <= '2013-07-15') GROUP BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, TraficSourceID
queries.description: For users exposed to ad traffic in the first half of July, shows which traffic sources brought them back in the second half and how engaged those visits were.

queries.sql: SELECT URLCategoryID, CounterID, users, rnk FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID, CounterID, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY URLCategoryID ORDER BY users DESC, CounterID) AS rnk FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID, CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY URLCategoryID, CounterID) AS a) AS r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY URLCategoryID, rnk LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each URL category, the three counters with the most engaged (non-bounce) users.

queries.sql: SELECT FLOOR(LENGTH(URL) / 25.0) * 25 AS url_len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN UTMCampaign <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS campaign_hits, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_hits FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY FLOOR(LENGTH(URL) / 25.0) * 25 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY url_len_bucket LIMIT 40
queries.description: Buckets landing URLs by length in 25-character steps and shows campaign-tagged and engaged hits per bucket, keeping buckets with at least 100 hits.
